clue.text: Exercise with a woman and cause some irritation

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercise
Eve, the first woman in Genesis, stands for any woman

explanation.surface: Someone working out alongside a woman manages to annoy people.
explanation.definitionFit: To peeve someone is to annoy or vex them, a mild irritation.

clue.text: One came out badly in the ballot, being controversial

indicators.note: in says the jumbled letters sit inside the vote

parts.note: a poll is a ballot or vote

indicators.note: came out badly says the letters are scrambled

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
taken as written

explanation.surface: A candidate did poorly in the election, causing argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out badly' turns I + CAME into EMICA, set 'in' POLL.
explanation.definitionFit: Polemics are fierce arguments, so writing of that sort is contentious and disputatious.

clue.text: Composer of "The Spanish Fish"

parts.note: el is Spanish for the
a gar is a long-snouted fish

explanation.surface: A musician wrote a piece called The Spanish Fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Edward Elgar wrote the Enigma Variations, an English composer.

clue.text: A European schoolboy clutching a shilling

indicators.note: clutching says the schoolboy holds the shilling inside

parts.note: an Etonian is a pupil at Eton, the English public school
s was the abbreviation for the old British shilling

explanation.surface: A boy from a European country grips a coin.
explanation.walkthrough: Eton is an English boarding school; the shilling was a pre-1971 British coin.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of the Baltic state with Tallinn as capital is a European.

clue.text: Tax Peter I arranged to abolish

indicators.note: arranged says the letters of these three words are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A ruler named Peter the First decides to scrap a tax.
explanation.definitionFit: To extirpate is to root out or destroy completely, a synonym for wiping something out.

clue.text: It's sound, on reflection.

parts.note: a noise that bounces back off a wall or cliff is literally sound being reflected, though the surface suggests careful thought

explanation.definitionFit: A repeated noise caused by sound waves bouncing off a surface is reflected sound.

clue.text: They never take steps to maintain silence!

definitions.text: They never take steps to maintain silence!

parts.words: They never take steps to maintain silence
parts.note: performers whose steps are deliberately noisy, with metal plates on their shoes, never move quietly

explanation.definitionFit: Dancers with metal-tipped shoes make rhythmic clicks with every step, so their steps are never silent.

clue.text: Soldiers give up and fall back

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, British army soldiers
to cede is to surrender or give up

explanation.surface: Troops surrender and retreat.
explanation.definitionFit: To withdraw or retreat is to move away backwards.

clue.text: Juxtaposed in a scalene triangle

definitions.meaning: a triangle with three unequal sides must contain one that is longest

explanation.definitionFit: Placed beside or next to; and every unequal-sided triangle includes one side longer than the others.

clue.text: Some of the men don't improve

indicators.note: Some of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Not all the men refuse to get better.
explanation.definitionFit: To correct or amend a text is to make it better.

clue.text: Lands fruit — and that's where the main danger is

definitions.text: that's where the main danger is

parts.note: to light is to alight or come down, so lights means lands
a hip is the fruit of the rose

explanation.surface: Someone picks fruit, and a warning follows about where peril lies at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the main' is the sea: a moored vessel with a beacon marks a hazard such as a sandbank.
explanation.definitionFit: A moored vessel carrying a beacon is stationed at a hazard to shipping on the open sea.

clue.text: Stop up for the finish

explanation.surface: Seal something off for the end.
explanation.definitionFit: To shut is to seal or stop up; a conclusion or end is also the word as a noun.

clue.text: Damage in a docking facility

parts.note: to mar is to damage or spoil
taken as written

explanation.surface: A boat is damaged while berthed at a harbour.
explanation.definitionFit: A harbour with moorings for yachts and small boats is a place where vessels dock.

clue.text: Players long past their best wrapped up well

parts.note: musicians playing together form a band
old, or aged

explanation.surface: Ageing musicians are bundled up warmly against the cold.
explanation.definitionFit: Dressed with strips of cloth around a wound, a limb is thoroughly wrapped.

clue.text: Tried if car smash results in manslaughter

indicators.note: smash says the letters of these words are broken up and reassembled

explanation.surface: A driver goes on trial after a car crash ends in a death.
explanation.definitionFit: Killing one's own brother is a specific kind of homicide.

clue.text: A monster bird followed by a second

parts.note: a cock is a male bird
a trice is an instant, a second

explanation.surface: A fearsome beast is described as a bird with something trailing behind.
explanation.definitionFit: A mythical serpent hatched from a cockerel's egg, whose glance could kill: a legendary beast.

clue.text: Grabbing everyone brought up in disheartening surroundings

indicators.note: in says the reversed word goes inside, with surroundings marking the outer word

parts.note: coring removes the heart or core of a fruit

indicators.note: brought up in a down clue says the word for everyone is read upwards

parts.note: all means everyone

explanation.surface: Seizing people, all raised in gloomy surroundings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought up' turns ALL into LLA, set 'in' CORING.
explanation.definitionFit: Seizing someone by the neck, or catching an offender, is to nab them.

clue.text: Charitable group

explanation.definitionFit: Generous and benevolent people are good-hearted; a sort or category of things is also the word.

clue.text: Find a record concerning York ist leader

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record
over means about, as in arguing over something

indicators.note: leader says take the first letter of Yorkist

explanation.surface: Someone unearths a document about a Yorkist commander.
explanation.definitionFit: A discovery is a find, something newly come upon.

clue.text: The flyover?

parts.note: a road bridge carrying traffic above another road is literally an elevated route

explanation.definitionFit: A road raised up on a bridge above others is literally an elevated way.

clue.text: Three pupils taking in nothing lounge about

indicators.note: taking in says the pupils hold the zero inside them

parts.note: L is a learner driver, so three pupils are LLL
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Three schoolchildren, doing no work at all, slouch around.
explanation.walkthrough: L for learner is from the L-plate a British learner driver displays.
explanation.definitionFit: To loll is to sprawl or lie around lazily, as an idler does.

clue.text: Intrudes awkwardly in sea-going craft — or might

indicators.note: in says the rearranged letters go inside the vessel

parts.note: SS is a steamship

indicators.note: awkwardly says the letters of intrudes are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone clumsily forces their way aboard a ship, or perhaps not.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awkwardly' turns INTRUDES into TURDINES, which goes 'in' SS.
explanation.definitionFit: Robustness and strength are what might means as a noun: physical power.

clue.text: High-powered firm

explanation.definitionFit: Potent and forceful; also sturdy and solid.

clue.text: Sort of banana has insect visible on the outside

indicators.note: on the outside says the word for visible wraps around the insect

parts.note: plain means clearly seen
an ant is an insect

explanation.surface: A banana has a bug crawling on its skin.
explanation.definitionFit: A starchy cooking fruit of the banana family, eaten widely in the tropics.

clue.text: Covenants to do something in addition to writing

indicators.note: in says the action goes inside the postscript

parts.note: PS, postscript, is added to the end of a letter
to act is to do something

explanation.surface: Agreements must be acted upon as well as put on paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Formal agreements or treaties between parties are compacts.

clue.text: An oriental cult therefore without taste

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the word for therefore surrounds the taste

parts.note: so means therefore
a hint is a slight taste

explanation.surface: An Eastern sect is consequently bland.
explanation.definitionFit: The native religion of Japan, with shrines to the kami, is an Eastern faith.

clue.text: Diana was the making of this nymph

indicators.note: was the making of says Diana's letters are made into something new

explanation.surface: The goddess Diana made this nymph what she was.
explanation.definitionFit: A water spirit of springs and rivers in Greek myth is a nymph.

clue.text: Take a turn serving up drinks

indicators.note: serving up in a down clue says the word for drinks is read upwards

parts.note: nips are small drinks of spirits

explanation.surface: Take your turn serving the drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: To rotate or whirl round is to go round in a circle.

clue.text: Capital atmosphere found in the small business house

indicators.note: found in says the atmosphere sits inside the company abbreviation

parts.note: Co is the short form of company, a business house
air is the atmosphere

explanation.surface: There is a pleasant atmosphere inside a little firm in the capital.
explanation.definitionFit: The Egyptian seat of government on the Nile is a capital city.

clue.text: To do without preparation is better all round

indicators.note: all round says the word for better encircles is

parts.note: to improve is to make or get better
taken as written

explanation.surface: It is better to act spontaneously, says a piece of advice.
explanation.definitionFit: To ad-lib or extemporise is to perform with no rehearsal.

clue.text: Dull-coloured plant on public land

parts.note: sage is a herb
a village green is common land

explanation.surface: A drab herb grows on the common.
explanation.definitionFit: A muted greyish-green shade like the herb's leaves is a dull colour.

clue.text: Within. 24 hours the minister will be a father

indicators.note: within says the minister sits inside the day

parts.note: a day lasts 24 hours
DD is Doctor of Divinity, a qualified minister

explanation.surface: In a day's time the clergyman will become a parent.
explanation.definitionFit: The familiar word a child uses for its male parent.
